items.title: ActiveCloud (Belarus) cloud provider hit by ransomware
items.summary: Belarusian cloud host ActiveCloud disclosed a Nov 11 ransomware attack that encrypted parts of its infrastructure, disrupting hosted sites, SmartMail email and virtual servers (including Domino's Belarus); most services were restored by Nov 13 with no evidence of customer data theft.

items.title: Nota Groep listed on ransomware leak site
items.summary: Transportation-sector firm Nota Groep appeared on a ransomware group's leak site on Nov 10; the claim is not yet confirmed by the victim.

items.title: Ransomware claims up 23% in Q3 2026
items.summary: NCC Group recorded 2,865 ransomware victim claims in Q3 2026, a 23% rise, with industrial organizations the most-targeted sector.

ransomware.note: Thin named-victim coverage this cycle; additional Nov 9–13 leak-site posts (n0n, Storm-1567, Everest) did not name victims.

items.title: Microsoft 365 outage (Nov 12–13)
items.summary: A significant Microsoft 365 disruption, logged as incidents EX1550543 and MO1550821 rather than an Azure platform incident, affected Outlook and related services across several regions.

items.title: M365 outage knock-on impact to business, government and AI connectors
items.summary: Last week's Microsoft disruption hit businesses, government agencies and healthcare organisations, and OpenAI and Anthropic reported Microsoft connector issues.

outage.note: No confirmed AWS or Google Cloud platform outage found for November 2026.

items.title: CISA warns Node2Shell (Brotli) flaw under active exploitation
items.summary: CISA confirmed attackers are exploiting the critical Node2Shell vulnerability and added it to the KEV catalog.

items.title: Four KEV adds: GPUStack, FreeSWITCH, OpenSSH, IBM Aspera Faspex
items.summary: CISA added four exploited flaws on Nov 9 with a Nov 12 federal remediation deadline.

items.title: Six KEV adds incl. Outlook, Chrome, Barracuda, Cisco BroadWorks
items.summary: CISA added six exploited vulnerabilities on Nov 10 affecting Microsoft Outlook, Google Chrome, Barracuda appliances, Cisco BroadWorks and Openwave Webtop.

items.title: Ivanti Connect Secure flaws — KEV deadline Nov 13
items.summary: Exploited Ivanti Connect Secure vulnerabilities were added to KEV with a Nov 13 remediation deadline for federal agencies.

items.title: Metabase zero-day enables unauthenticated admin takeover
items.summary: CVE-2026-72898 in Metabase lets unauthenticated attackers gain administrator access and exfiltrate sensitive data; CISA added it alongside Windows and Cisco Secure Firewall flaws.

items.title: Zyxel GS1900 zero-day used to hijack ~1,000 switches
items.summary: Attackers exploited CVE-2026-107441 in Zyxel GS1900 switches to take over roughly 1,000 devices.

items.title: M 6.6 — 148 km WSW of Tual, Indonesia (Nov 16)
items.summary: Strong offshore earthquake in the Banda Sea region; USGS green alert, no tsunami.

items.title: M 5.3 — 16 km ESE of Comandău, Romania (Nov 18)
items.summary: Moderate earthquake in the Vrancea seismic zone, felt regionally; no USGS PAGER alert.

items.title: Cyclone Murasu landfall in Andhra Pradesh, India
items.summary: Cyclone Murasu made landfall on the Andhra Pradesh coast on Nov 3, the second cyclone there in under a week.

items.title: Storms in Santa Catarina, Brazil
items.summary: Santa Catarina reported 671 storm-related incidents across 76 municipalities on Nov 4–5.

items.title: Deadly flooding across Ecuador
items.summary: Heavy rain and flooding across Ecuador had caused 12 deaths as of Nov 5.

physical.note: Most recent non-seismic items date from early November; no current November 2026 wildfire reports found.
